question: Does ASCII whitespace stripping improve exact final-output accuracy over lowercasing alone on the seven frozen boolean-parser tasks?

candidates.name: Lowercase-only parser
candidates.summary: For each string, compute lower(); return Python True for token true, False for token false, otherwise the string invalid. Do not strip whitespace.

hard_constraints.reason: No final outputs or parent receipt.

candidates.name: ASCII-strip then lowercase parser
candidates.summary: For each string, compute strip(" \t\n\r\v\f").lower(); use exactly A's true/false/invalid validation and return types.

hard_constraints.reason: No final outputs or parent receipt.

experiments.hypothesis: B improves exact-match accuracy by at least one of seven tasks through ASCII whitespace normalization.
controls: Read PROJECT-relative tasks.json unchanged; retain t0-t6 and frozen labels.
Use identical Python runtime, permissions and budgets.
Invoke each actual function once per input: fourteen invocations total.
Differ only by B's specified ASCII strip step.
Export actual returns separately from labels; preserve wrong outputs and failure details.
metrics: A typed whole-JSON exact matches divided by seven
B typed whole-JSON exact matches divided by seven
Paired difference: B accuracy minus A accuracy
experiments.acceptance: A complete measurement requires fourteen actual return records, seven per candidate, frozen grading and a successful parent-owned E1 receipt without timeout or truncation. Recommend B only if all hard constraints pass and its measured gain is at least one additional correct task (1/7). Equal or worse results remain valid findings. Missing returns, errors or timeouts remain failures, never imputed successes; incomplete execution leaves the decision deferred.
experiments.planned_output: JSON containing task ID, input, frozen expected value, candidate ID, actual typed return value or execution failure, exact-match result, both mean scores and paired difference. The later asset unit declares the comparison script and generated artifact paths; this unit creates neither.
